summary: {person} puts two bus maps in front of residents who want both nearby stops and shorter waits.
realLife: Milwaukee’s transit agency presented a ridership concept with fewer, more frequent routes and a coverage concept reaching more places at lower frequency.
gates: Residents can compare two proposed networks under the same funding assumption.
weights: A household far from frequent service may value the two maps differently.
inGame: needs: two proposed networks, comparable resource assumptions and current service map.
